name: Gretha Catharina Jung

events.title: Mother at baptisms
events.description: Named as Peter Grub's wife 'Gretha Catharina' (1684) and 'Margretha Catharina' (1687)

bioAdditions: The site's 'Gretha Catharina Jung' merges two women. Johann Peter Grub's first wife was Gretha (Margretha) Catharina, named in the Reichenbach baptisms of their daughters in 1684 and 1687 (S1, S2). FamilySearch gives her surname as unknown and her death as before Oct 1694 (S3). On 19 Oct 1694 Peter married Elisabetha Catharina Jung (c.1674-1734), daughter of Paul Jung and Maria Barbara of Jettenbach. It is she who died on 28 Mar 1734, the death date the site gives this person (S4). If Johann Nickel Grub (c.1694) was born before October 1694, as FamilySearch has it, John descends from the first wife, whose surname is unknown, and not from the Jungs through this line. The Jungs remain John's ancestors either way, through Maria Sara Jung, mother of Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert (see H0075 and H0082).
